verdict.rationale: vLLM ships as a pip/uv-installable Python package that runs as an OpenAI-compatible API server process with no GUI component, and community commentary confirms its architecture separates the web server from the GPU inference process — consistent with headless server/CI use. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation or CI examples (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes deployment guides) explicitly describing headless CI pipeline usage, and no independent hands-on report confirming CI integration.
